description: Small circular depression with a ring outline ~65 m across on the floodplain
assessment: Moderate candidate (est. ~60% human-made, range 45-70%). Raw LAZ re-classified 7 ways (vendor, SMRF default/conservative/permissive, CSF flat/relief, PMF): ring stable in all (ditch radius 31.6-33.6 m, closure 96-100%, interior 2.45-2.64 m above ditch floor, outer edge 1.25-1.47 m above floor excl. permissive settings; cut 1,470-2,510 m3 vs fill 800-1,220 m3). Not an interpolation artefact: ground points alone show the ditch lower than both sides in 8-10 of 12 sectors, interior higher in 12/12; ditch has real returns (0.3-0.5/m2; 84-95% of ditch cells within 4 m of a ground point). Ditch floor is level (no grade toward any outlet: amp 0.06-0.11 m, p=0.46-0.75) whereas natural gully/interfluve rings slope (NW island 250 m away 0.59 m, knob in polygon 004 0.18 m, interfluves in polygons 003/143 0.85 m, all p<=0.002); half the ring is a closed depression up to 1.2 m deep. Only clean ring in ~20 km2 of the same terrace (granules 212_0/1 searched with the same detector). Interior had lower, more open canopy in 2014 (median 8.8 m vs 17 m around; 39% of cells <3 m) - common for old clearings but also seen in other fallow patches. Against: gullies join the ring at E and NW; no outer bank; dome not flat-topped; sparse ground under forest. Needs a field check (auger/test pit). Figures: docs/figures/l66/. | Point-cloud check: weak+ (still possible). Real ground (0.3 pts/m2, 3,300 pts in 100x100 m): near-closed ring ditch, radius 24-37 m (mean 33, sd 5), 1.3 m below the terrace and 2.4 m below a domed interior (~45 m across, summit +1.1 m over terrace); cut ~1,500 m3 vs interior fill ~1,200 m3. Forested in 2014 (10-16 m canopy), no modern trace on Esri. Not in Kapuas Hulu cagar budaya lists (Jangkang, Putussibau Utara). Against: ring joins a natural dendritic gully network on a river terrace beside a large palaeo-meander; at least one similar rounded island 250 m NW at the swath edge; dome not flat-topped; no outer bank. Natural island/meander core equally plausible. | Initial reading: Natural pond or cut-off hollow
